e.title: ASB（美国精算实务准则委员会）：ASOP 可筛选库与公开征求意见稿
e.title_en: ASB (US Actuarial Standards Board): a filterable ASOP library and public exposure drafts
e.title_hk: ASB（美國精算實務準則委員會）：ASOP 可篩選庫與公開徵求意見稿
e.summary: 美国制定精算实务准则（ASOP）的机构：以按业务领域（意外险/ERM/通用/健康/寿险/养老金，含已废止）筛选的准则库为核心，并公开在征与往期征求意见稿
e.summary_en: The body that sets US Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOPs): its core is a standards library filterable by practice area (casualty, ERM, general, health, life, pension, and repealed), alongside ongoing and past exposure drafts
e.summary_hk: 美國制定精算實務準則（ASOP）的機構：以按業務領域（意外險／ERM／通用／健康／壽險／養老金，含已廢止）篩選的準則庫為核心，並公開在徵與往期徵求意見稿
e.body:
**ASB（Actuarial Standards Board，美国精算实务准则委员会）** 是**美国制定精算实务准则的机构**。站点自述实测为 **「The Actuarial Standards Board (ASB) establishes and improves standards of actuarial practice」**，并写明 **「These Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOPs) identify what the actuary should consider, document, and dis[close]」**。本条目补的是**「精算准则的可检索库 + 公开立规流程」这一形态**——**池内最接近的是 [[aae]]（欧洲精算协会的欧洲精算实务准则）**，**但那条我上一轮只核实到准则页的存在，且其形态是「区域准则发布方」**；**ASB 补上的是该形态没有的东西：按业务领域筛选的准则库、已废止准则、以及在征/往期征求意见稿**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **首页 67.2KB，标题实测「Home - Actuarial Standards Board」**；⭐ **「Standards of Practice（实务准则）」页 `/standards-of-practice/` 实测 121.7KB**，**页面实测带按业务领域的筛选入口**：**`#filter=*`（全部）**、**`.Casualty`（意外险）**、**`.ERM`（企业风险管理）**、**`.General`（通用）**、**`.Health`（健康）**、**`.Life`（寿险）**、**`.Pension`（养老金）**，⭐ **以及 `.Repealed`（已废止）**——**即已废止准则仍保留可查**；⭐ **「Ongoing Exposure Drafts（在征征求意见稿）」页 `/drafts/ongoing-exposure-drafts/` 实测 75.4KB**，另有 **`/drafts/past-exposure-drafts/`（往期征求意见稿）**、**`/site-map/`** 与 **`/contact/`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「准则的可检索化与时效管理」这一做法**——**准则不是一份 PDF，而是可按业务领域筛选的库，且明确区分现行与已废止**；**对做精算工作底稿或复核的学生，「哪一条 ASOP 管这件事、它是否已被废止」是可以直接查的**（可与 [[aae]] 的欧洲准则、[[iais-icp]] 的保险核心原则并读——**一条是执业准则、一条是监管原则，层级不同**）。**② ⭐ 「公开征求意见稿」这一流程本身就是教学材料**——**准则怎么被修改、业界怎么反馈**都留痕；**这与池内 [[eiopa-registers]] 的「监管报送 DPM/XBRL」、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 的监管态势聚合不同**——**那些是监管产出，这是职业自律的立规过程**。**③ 按业务领域分类的七个维度是一份现成的「精算业务领域清单」**——**对刚入行、不确定精算分几条线的学生，这个筛选器本身就是一张地图**（可与 [[cas-syllabus]]、[[soa-education]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]] 的考试分科并读——**考试分科与准则领域不完全重合，这个差异本身值得注意**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与准则页、在征征求意见稿页的存在、标题、体量、筛选维度（含 Repealed）、以及往期征求意见稿与站点地图的链接存在**，**但未打开任何一条 ASOP 正文、未打开任何一份征求意见稿、未核实准则总数**，因此**不能转述任何 ASOP 的编号、条款内容或适用范围**；**② 首页正文我只读到一个被截断的句子片段**（**「…should consider, document, and dis」**）——**故词条内只引用到该片段为止，不补全其后的词**；**③ 「ASB 与 AAA（美国精算师协会）、ABCD 的关系」本次未核实**（**本轮的 [[abcd]] 条目同属美国精算自律体系，但两者的制度关系本词条不作主张**）；**④ 筛选维度实测为 URL 片段形式（`#filter=…`）**，**其是否为前端筛选、是否需要 JS 本次未核实**；**⑤ ASB 的成员构成与任命方式未核实**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** ASB 提供精算软件、模型或数据**。**核实说明**：首页（67.2KB）、`/standards-of-practice/`（121.7KB）、`/drafts/ongoing-exposure-drafts/`（75.4KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取筛选维度与自述；**未打开任何 ASOP 正文或征求意见稿**。
e.body_en:
**ASB (the Actuarial Standards Board)** is **the body that sets actuarial standards of practice in the United States**. Its own measured wording is **"The Actuarial Standards Board (ASB) establishes and improves standards of actuarial practice"**, adding that **"These Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOPs) identify what the actuary should consider, document, and dis[close]"**. This entry adds the **"searchable standards library plus open standard-setting process"** form — **the closest corpus item is [[aae]] (the Actuarial Association of Europe and its European standards of actuarial practice)**, **but that entry verified only the existence of its standards page and its form is "a regional standards publisher"**; **ASB supplies what that form lacked: a library filterable by practice area, repealed standards, and ongoing and past exposure drafts**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **homepage is 67.2KB with the measured title "Home - Actuarial Standards Board"**; ⭐ the **"Standards of Practice" page `/standards-of-practice/` measures 121.7KB**, **measurably carrying filter entry points by practice area**: **`#filter=*` (all)**, **`.Casualty`**, **`.ERM`**, **`.General`**, **`.Health`**, **`.Life`**, **`.Pension`**, ⭐ and **`.Repealed`** — **i.e. repealed standards remain searchable**; ⭐ the **"Ongoing Exposure Drafts" page measures 75.4KB**, with **`/drafts/past-exposure-drafts/`**, **`/site-map/`** and **`/contact/`** also present.

For RIAA: **① it adds "making standards searchable and managing their currency"** — **a standard is not a PDF but a library filterable by practice area that explicitly separates current from repealed**; **for students preparing actuarial work papers or reviews, "which ASOP governs this, and has it been repealed" becomes directly checkable** (readable with the European standards in [[aae]] and the insurance core principles in [[iais-icp]] — **one is practice standards, one regulatory principles, at different levels**). **② ⭐ The public exposure-draft process is itself teaching material** — **how a standard is amended and how the industry responds is all on record**; **this differs from the regulatory reporting DPM/XBRL in [[eiopa-registers]] and the regulatory-posture aggregation in [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]** — **those are supervisory outputs; this is rule-making within a profession’s self-regulation**. **③ The seven practice-area filters are a ready-made list of actuarial practice areas** — **for a newcomer unsure how many lines actuarial work divides into, the filter itself is a map** (readable with the examination structures in [[cas-syllabus]], [[soa-education]] and [[actuarial-exam-database]] — **exam streams and standards areas do not fully coincide, and that difference is itself worth noting**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and sizes of the homepage, the standards page and the ongoing exposure drafts page, the filter dimensions (including Repealed), and the presence of past exposure drafts and the site map as links**, **but opened no ASOP text, no exposure draft, and did not establish how many standards exist**, so **no ASOP number, clause content or scope can be restated**; **② the homepage body was read only as a truncated sentence fragment** (**"…should consider, document, and dis"**) — **so the entry quotes no further than that fragment and does not complete the word**; **③ the relationship between the ASB, the AAA (American Academy of Actuaries) and the ABCD was not verified** (**this round’s [[abcd]] entry belongs to the same US actuarial self-regulation system, but this entry makes no claim about their institutional relationship**); **④ the filter dimensions were measured as URL fragments (`#filter=…`)**, and **whether filtering is client-side and requires JavaScript was not verified**; **⑤ the ASB’s membership and appointment were not verified**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim the ASB provides actuarial software, models or data**. **Verification note**: the homepage (67.2KB), `/standards-of-practice/` (121.7KB) and `/drafts/ongoing-exposure-drafts/` (75.4KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with filter dimensions and self-description read verbatim; **no ASOP text or exposure draft was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**ASB（Actuarial Standards Board，美國精算實務準則委員會）** 是**美國制定精算實務準則的機構**。站點自述實測為 **「The Actuarial Standards Board (ASB) establishes and improves standards of actuarial practice」**，並寫明 **「These Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOPs) identify what the actuary should consider, document, and dis…」**。本條目補的是**「精算準則的可檢索庫 + 公開立規流程」這一形態**——**池內最接近的是 [[aae]]（歐洲精算實務準則）**，**但 ASB 補上該形態沒有的東西：按業務領域篩選的準則庫、已廢止準則、以及在徵／往期徵求意見稿**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **首頁 67.2KB，標題「Home - Actuarial Standards Board」**；⭐ **「Standards of Practice」頁 121.7KB**，⭐ **實測帶業務領域篩選入口**：**`#filter=*`／`.Casualty`／`.ERM`／`.General`／`.Health`／`.Life`／`.Pension`**，⭐ 以及 **`.Repealed`（已廢止）**——**已廢止準則仍保留可查**；⭐ **「Ongoing Exposure Drafts」頁 75.4KB**，另有 **`/drafts/past-exposure-drafts/`／`/site-map/`／`/contact/`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「準則的可檢索化與時效管理」這一做法**——**準則不是一份 PDF，而是可按業務領域篩選、且明確區分現行與已廢止的庫**；**對做工作底稿或複核的學生，「哪一條 ASOP 管這件事、是否已廢止」可直接查**（可與 [[aae]]、[[iais-icp]] 並讀）。**② ⭐ 「公開徵求意見稿」流程本身就是教學材料**——**準則怎麼被修改、業界怎麼反饋都留痕**；**與 [[eiopa-registers]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 的監管產出不同，這是職業自律的立規過程**。**③ 七個業務領域篩選是一份現成的「精算業務領域清單」**——**對剛入行的學生，這個篩選器本身就是一張地圖**（可與 [[cas-syllabus]]、[[soa-education]] 並讀——**考試分科與準則領域不完全重合，這個差異值得注意**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁、準則頁、在徵徵求意見稿頁的存在、標題、體量、篩選維度（含 Repealed）、以及往期徵求意見稿與站點地圖的連結存在**，**但未打開任何一條 ASOP 正文、未打開任何一份徵求意見稿、未核實準則總數**，故**不能轉述任何 ASOP 編號、條款內容或適用範圍**；**② 首頁正文我只讀到一個被截斷的句子片段，故詞條內只引用到該片段為止**；**③ ASB 與 AAA、ABCD 的關係本次未核實**；**④ 篩選維度實測為 URL 片段形式，是否需 JS 未核實**；**⑤ 成員構成與任命方式未核實**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** ASB 提供精算軟件、模型或數據**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何 ASOP 正文或徵求意見稿**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（首页 67.2KB 标题「Home - Actuarial Standards Board」，正文实测含「The Actuarial Standards Board (ASB) establishes and improves standards of actuarial practice」「These Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOPs) identify what the actuary should consider, document, and dis…」（截断处即止）；⭐/standards-of-practice/ 121.7KB，实测筛选入口 #filter=* / .Casualty / .ERM / .General / .Health / .Life / .Pension / .Repealed；⭐/drafts/ongoing-exposure-drafts/ 75.4KB「Ongoing Exposure Drafts」；另实测 /drafts/past-exposure-drafts/ 与 /site-map/ 链接存在）+ ★与池内 aae（欧洲准则）同形态，本条目按重复纪律补「按业务领域可筛选库 + 已废止准则 + 公开征求意见稿流程」；未打开任何 ASOP 正文或征求意见稿、未核实准则总数；ASB 与 AAA/ABCD 的制度关系与成员构成本次未核实
